card: Updates release note snippet files to reference version 32.1 instead of 32.0 and adds missing PR numbers across 16 doc files. It cleans up pending release documentation to improve tracking and future aggregation. The PR touches only documentation files.
evidence: PR description: '32.0 -> 32.1. Add some missing PR #s (needed if #36769 happens more).'
problem: Draft release note snippets had incorrect target release versions and omitted PR references, complicating documentation aggregation.

risk.why: A typo or mistake in release note snippets would only affect release documentation text.

summary: Updates release note snippets across 16 documentation files by bumping target version strings (e.g. from 32.0 to 32.1) and adding missing pull request numbers.
